answer.text: Mandated by SEBI as a choice to investors (no distribution fee channel)

explanation.text: The Logic: Portfolio managers are required to provide an option to clients to be on-boarded directly, without intermediation of a distributor, and to prominently disclose this option in their disclosure documents and on their website. The Trap: It is not prohibited — it is a mandatory option that the PM must offer. Note: In the direct on-boarding route, no charges other than statutory charges are levied on the client. This direct option does not apply to co-investment portfolio management services.
